Metadata.title: Document Q&A
Metadata.description: Citable answers from Persian and English documents

Home.title: Find the knowledge hidden in your documents.
Home.description: Add Persian or English documents, ask a question, and receive an answer whose claims you can inspect at the source.
Home.workflowDescription: Every answer is composed from relevant passages and links back to the original page.
Home.stepOneBody: Upload a PDF or text file with clear processing progress.
Home.stepTwoBody: Your question and source can be Persian or English.
Home.stepThreeBody: See the answer, page, and supporting passage together.
Home.foundationBody: This baseline verifies the secure, versioned connection between the interface and API.
Home.statusHint: For local development, run the backend on port 8000.
